title: Blog Post Content
description: Single blog post template (single.php), Figma frame 134:113 ("Desktop Blog Post", file "Untitled", vzdpOnH1U36oXcFcugiyE5). The hero photo is the post's native Featured Image, not a field here — WordPress already has that mechanism. The one thing the design draws that WordPress has no native slot for is the embedded-video block between the second and third content sections (134:151): a clickable thumbnail over a photo, optional per post. It renders with the design's own stock photo and play button whenever a URL is set here, and is skipped entirely otherwise — the same design-fidelity-fallback-until-skip convention testimonials.php and ci-hero.php's image branches use.

fields.label: Featured Video URL
fields.name: blog_video_url
fields.instructions: Optional. Renders the video block after the second section of the article, matching Figma node 134:151. Left empty, the block is skipped rather than shown as a dead link.
